title: SILENCE — The Listener
provenance: Original model and materials authored for SILENCE; no third-party model data.
process: Blender 5.1 continuous voxel sculpt with carved face and teeth, asymmetric spines and torn fascia, manifold topology cleanup, anatomical bone/tendon/rot color atlas, baked normal and roughness maps, 50-bone rig with rigid toe contacts, independent cold ivory emissive eyes.
articulation: Weighted neck, head, jaw, forearms, wrists and two joints on each of eight fingers; skull-bound emissive eyes; independent held gaze and grip intentions.
